item.title: D-Wave Publishes Research on Dual-Rail Qubit Gate for Quantum Error Correction
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – D-Wave Quantum Inc. (Nasdaq: QBTS), (“D-Wave” or the “Company”), the only dual-platform quantum computing company providing both annealing and gate-model systems, software, and services, today announced a major research breakthrough advancing the path to practical, fault-tolerant gate-model quantum computing.
